label: Thomas Aquinas, Summa theologiae I q.3 a.7…: Whatever is composed of matter and form, or has an…
locator: I q.3 a.7 co., first proof: neque compositio formae et materiae ... neque aliud essentia et esse
interpretation: The first proof treats matter-form composition (q.3 a.2) and the distinction of essence and esse (q.3 a.4) as kinds of composition. Only that inclusion is read here; the proof's other claim, that the listed kinds exhaust composition, is not formalized.
